metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A quintessential teen comedy that matches the sharp wit and high-school dynamics of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: An uplifting, fashionable, and lighthearted comedy about a positive woman proving herself, much like the lead in Clueless.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A clever, modern teen comedy with a great lead performance that pairs well with 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A high-octane space adventure with a heavy emphasis on humor and character chemistry, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A fast-paced, stylish action-comedy with quirky characters and witty banter like The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: The predecessor to your watched Knives Out mystery, offering the same blend of humor and clever puzzle-solving.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A colorful, fun, and high-energy mystery that fits your interest in the Knives Out series.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The perfect blend of fantasy, action-adventure, and lighthearted comedy, matching the tone of Jumanji and D&D.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A charming and fun fantasy adventure with a touch of romance, similar to the vibe of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A classic 'feel-good' fantasy comedy that features adventure, romance, and plenty of iconic humor.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by the same creator as The Nice Guys, it offers a similar blend of crime, mystery, and hilarious buddy-comedy.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A fast-moving comedy-mystery that provides the same kind of group-dynamic fun found in Jumanji: The Next Level.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A vibrant action-comedy set in a video game world, aligning with the adventure and humor of the new Jumanji films.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: If you enjoyed the irreverent, cringe-comedy style of Brüno, this is the essential next step from Sacha Baron Cohen.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: A high-energy, slapstick comedy that matches the Jim Carrey energy you liked in Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
metas.description: A colorful and absurd comedy that captures the same era of fun found in 90s comedies like Get Shorty.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: High-octane action with a fun, slightly over-the-top tone that fits your interest in Marvel and Pacific Rim: Uprising.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A fun jungle adventure rom-com that shares the DNA of Jumanji and lighthearted fantasy-adventures.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A stylish, cool, and comedic crime caper that matches the sophisticated vibe of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliantly paced action-comedy with a mystery element, perfect for fans of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern, hilarious, and uplifting teen comedy that follows in the footsteps of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with a big heart and a heavy focus on comedy and fun, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Howl's Moving Castle
metas.description: An imaginative and beautifully animated fantasy that captures the whimsical spirit of Night is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate comfort movie; it is light, beautifully shot, and incredibly heartwarming for a relaxing night.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, funny, and lighthearted romantic comedy with a sci-fi twist that feels fresh and fun.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A feel-good romantic story with a fantasy element, similar to the grounded magic in Practical Magic.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy that subverts expectations, offering high-stakes fun and constant laughs.

metas.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: A visually stunning and high-energy adventure with great humor, matching the fun of D&D: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All At Once
metas.description: A wild, imaginative blend of sci-fi, action, and comedy that fans of Thor and D&D will appreciate.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A loving parody of sci-fi that is genuinely funny and adventurous, fitting the 'light and fun' filter perfectly.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: An 80s classic that combines fantasy, action, and comedy in a way that fans of D&D and Thor: Ragnarok will love.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A lighthearted fantasy romance about time travel that captures a whimsical, comfortable atmosphere.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: A high-octane, funny, and irreverent superhero film that matches the comedic tone of Brüno and Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: An incredibly fun and stylish action-adventure that is visually dazzling and uplifting.

metas.name: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
metas.description: The ultimate 'relaxing' comedy about having fun and taking a break, fitting your desire for comfort cinema.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A light, music-filled ensemble comedy that provides easy watching and plenty of laughs.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy reboot that focuses on friendship and absurd situations, like The Nice Guys.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: A fun, anachronistic medieval adventure with romance and a great soundtrack, starring Heath Ledger from 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: An absurd and hilarious mockumentary that matches the satirical comedic energy of Brüno.

metas.name: The Fall Guy
metas.description: A recent action-romance-comedy that is pure entertainment, aligning with your love for high-octane fun.
